transcript:
Agent: Thank you for calling customer service. How can I help you today?
Customer: Hello dear, I'm looking at this paper bill that came in the mail, and something just doesn't look right to me.
Agent: I can certainly look into that for you. May I please have your full name and the mailing address on your account?
Customer: Yes, my name is Edna Pruitt, and I live at 414 Elm Street. I just don't understand what happened here.
Agent: Thank you, Ms. Pruitt. You're verified. Which charge on the statement are you calling about?
Customer: Well, it says Valuemax Home Shopping, but I'm just so confused about which one it is. It shouldn't be there, I don't think.
Agent: Okay, I see a charge from Valuemax Home Shopping from September 26th. Does that match what you are looking at?
Customer: Yes, September 26th. That sounds right. But like I said, a gentleman called me on the telephone earlier, and he was helping me fix my account.
Agent: Could you tell me a little more about that phone call?
Customer: He was very polite. He said there was trouble with my account and that he needed to get in and fix it for me. He had me do some things on my computer.
Agent: Did this person say he was calling from Valuemax Home Shopping, or from our company?
Customer: Oh goodness, I'm just not sure. I thought he said he was helping fix the shopping account, or maybe the bank. I get so mixed up with all these calls. He said he was fixing everything for me.
Agent: Did you place any orders with Valuemax Home Shopping yourself on September 26th?
Customer: No, I don't think so. I watch the channel sometimes, but I didn't buy anything that day. Or maybe I did, but the man told me he was going to fix it so I wouldn't have to worry.
Agent: Did you share your card details or give him remote access to your computer screen?
Customer: Yes, he told me to type some numbers in, and he was moving the little pointer on my screen. He said he was going to fix my account, but now I see this Valuemax Home Shopping item here.
Agent: Alright, Ms. Pruitt. So to make sure I understand, you see an item from Valuemax Home Shopping on September 26th, and around that time a man called saying he was helping fix your account, and he had you give him access to your computer.
Customer: Yes, that is exactly what happened. He said he was fixing it, but then that showed up, and I just don't know what's going on.
